target.value: NAPSS prepared, adopted, and presented to donors in 2011.

comment.narrative: Preparation of the NAPSS is underway. A NAPSS national consultant was hired by the Project and a NAPSS steering committee as wellas a NAPSS technical committee were created and meet monthly to agree on its content. There are some delays on receiving data fromDGS vulnerability missions, before the NAPSS workshop can be organized.

title.narrative: Methods for safe school construction are adopted

target.value: Methods for safe school construction are adopted in 2011

actual.value: Methods for safe schools construction are discussed in 2011 and 2012.

comment.narrative: The MENFP and the sub-group for school construction have received the draft NAPSS and will participate in the NAPSS NationalWorkshop. Since the NAPSS is not yet finalized, it cannot be adopted. However, individual donors habitually consult with the MENFPto ensure they finance safe school construction methods in accordance with the DGS guidelines. A School Construction Prototypetechnical group consisting of donors, the MENFP and others is currently finalizing school architectural models.
